title: fix: set minimum model RPM to 60
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Raises every configured canonical model RPM below 60 to 60.
- Preserves uncapped models, existing 60 RPM caps, and DreamShaper at 300 RPM.
- Adds a registry-wide regression assertion for the 60 RPM floor.
- Leaves community-owner limits unchanged.

Addresses #14326

gist.headline: The RPM floor blooms
gist.blurb: The slowest lanes in the model garden now run at 60 requests per minute. Uncapped models stay uncapped, and DreamShaper keeps its speedy 300 RPM patch.
gist.summary: Raised every capped canonical text, image, and audio model below 60 RPM to a 60 RPM minimum, while preserving uncapped models, existing 60 RPM caps, DreamShaper at 300 RPM, and community-owner limits.
gist.impact: Developers get a consistent minimum of 60 requests per minute across capped canonical models, with the existing higher and uncapped limits left intact.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model garden has several labeled request-rate pipes previously trickling at different speeds, now all reaching a clearly marked 60 RPM watering line. Polli, wearing a tiny gardener cap and carrying a wrench, adjusts the shared flow valve while a DreamShaper flower enjoys a larger 300 RPM sprinkler; code-plants and soft lime-green terminal displays make the rate-limit registry tangible.
